title: Sean McVay laughs as he says he's tempted to ask assistant coach Robert Woods to suit up

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay laughs as he says he's tempted to ask assistant coach Robert Woods to suit up
sources.description: He didn't sound completely serious, but Rams coach Sean McVay said on Wednesday that he talked to assistant wide receivers coach Robert Woods about whether he could suit up and play while receivers Puka Nacua, Davante Adams and Jordan Whittington are all out with injuries.
